optional.budgets.max_fix_iters_per_round: Implementer fix turns per review round (default: 3).
optional.budgets.max_iterations_per_ticket: Implementer turns before ticket is blocked (default: 12).
optional.budgets.test_timeout_seconds: Kill runaway tests after N seconds (default: 600).
optional.gates.protected_paths: Paths the implementer can never write (default: .env, secrets/).
optional.gates.max_deletions_per_iteration: Max lines the implementer may delete per iteration (default: 5 — prevents destructive whole-file rewrites, perfect for append-only tickets; consider a per-ticket override for rewording tickets)
optional.gates.require_human_approval_for_merge: Prompt before every merge (default: true — keep it).
optional.main_branch: Default branch of the product repo (default: main).
optional.models.cloud_fallback.api_key_env: Env var holding the OpenRouter key (default: OPENROUTER_API_KEY).
optional.models.cloud_fallback.model: OpenRouter model used when local calls fail.
optional.models.local.implementer: Model override for the implementer role.
optional.models.local.planner: Model override for the planner role.
optional.models.local.reviewer: Model override for the reviewer role.
optional.models.local.scout: Model override for the scout role.
optional.notifications.discord_webhook: Optional Discord webhook URL for cycle results.
optional.planner.enabled_for_feature_tickets: Run planner before implementer on type: feature (default: true).

description: Recursive development loop: AI agents continuously improve a codebase — ticket, isolated git worktree, implementer, tests, reviewer, human-approved merge. Local Ollama first, OpenRouter fallback.

bootstrap.description: Check prerequisites (Python, git, Ollama) and install Python dependencies.

run_cycle.description: Run one full improvement cycle for the next open ticket.

run_scout.description: Audit the product repo and propose new tickets into tickets/.

name: ouroboros

prerequisites.name: ollama
prerequisites.notes: At least one model pulled; names must match models.local.* exactly.

prerequisites.name: product_repo
prerequisites.notes: A git checkout with a working test suite, OUTSIDE this repo.

repository_layout.harness/: Loop controller. Owns all git operations and test runs. Agents never edit this at runtime.
repository_layout.prompts/: Role prompts (scout, implementer, reviewer, planner). Project-agnostic via {{PROJECT_*}} placeholders.
repository_layout.setup/: Installer scripts, agent setup procedure, this manifest.
repository_layout.tickets/: Backlog. TICKET-*.md files; orchestrator picks highest-priority open ticket.

safety_rules: Agents work in a disposable git worktree on a loop/* branch; main is only touched by a --no-ff merge after all gates pass.
Protected paths (.env, secrets/, ...) can never be written by the implementer; unsafe paths (.., absolute) are rejected in code.
Secrets never enter prompts; workers see ticket + code + test output only.
Human merge approval defaults to ON; --yes must never be used without explicit human approval.
Notifications never break a cycle; the planner is advisory and never fatal.

ticket_statuses.blocked: Implementer exhausted its budget (set by the harness).
ticket_statuses.done: Merged to main (set by the harness).
ticket_statuses.needs-human: Reviewer rejected, or merge declined (needs a human).
ticket_statuses.open: Ready for the loop to pick up.
